# Senior Marketing Operations Manager (remote US East Coast)

Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that manages your entire infrastructure lifecycle — provisioning, configuration and governance. Spacelift integrates with all your infrastructure tooling (e.g. Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible) to provide a single integrated workflow so you can deliver secure, cost-effective, and resilient infrastructure, fast.

By automating deployment and configuration, providing developer self-service, golden paths with guardrails, and an OPA policy engine, Spacelift empowers businesses to accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control and governance over their infrastructure. Spacelift offers unrivaled support, no-nonsense pricing, and a range of deployment models to fit your specific needs.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $31.3M in funding over three rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, and Inovo Venture partners.

**Spacelift is seeking a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to architect and optimize the systems that fuel our lead generation, SDR integration, and pipeline analytics.** This is a newly created role within a fast-growing organization, designed to unify and elevate Marketing Operations as a strategic partner to GTM leadership across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. It’s a perfect fit for someone who thrives on:

- Bringing clarity to go-to-market performance by connecting the dots across marketing, sales, and operations systems.

- Automating manual work and exploring the use of AI for upskilling the team

- Driving accountability and performance by equipping teams with clear, data-backed insights


**About the Role**

**Lead management and operations**

- Design and maintain automated lead routing, scoring, and enrichment workflows to support SDR productivity and ensure timely follow-up on high-intent leads

- Ensure team alignment on funnel metrics, SLAs, and attribution methodologies

- Identify trends and opportunities to optimize lead conversion and accelerate pipeline.


**Data management and reporting**

- Monitor data quality and hygiene across marketing systems, developing and enforcing standards for enrichment, deduplication, and normalization

- Build and maintain dashboards and performance reports for marketing, SDRs, and leadership — surfacing insights into lead flow, channel effectiveness, SLA enforcement and campaign ROI

- Develop and maintain data governance, reporting, and workflows to improve efficiency.

- Support campaign execution with scalable processes for tracking, attribution, and reporting across lifecycle stages


**Marketing process and technology**

- Serve as a trusted advisor on marketing technology and operations best practices.

- Ensure seamless integration of marketing tech stack, working cross-functionally with RevOps and Sales.


**About You**

- 3–5+ years of experience in B2B marketing operations

- Deep experience with GTM platforms including HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, Chili Piper, and Outreach

- Working knowledge of lead lifecycle, funnel analytics, attribution modeling, and campaign instrumentation

- Ability to translate business questions into technical requirements and build the reporting infrastructure to answer them

- High attention to detail, a systems mindset, and a love for process improvement

- Working applications of incorporating AI into team workflows to automate manual work and increase team effectiveness


**Hiring Process**

- 30 minutes with [Nuria Requena](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nuria-requena-4a30b255/), **Talent Acquisition Manager**

- 45 minutes introductory video call with [Gareth Kersey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/garethkersey/), **Senior Director of Growth Marketing**

- **Panel Presentation**

- Interview with [Dimitri Vlachos](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dvlachos/), **CMO**

- Final Cultural Interview with [Pawel Stajgis,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pawelstajgis/) **Director of Strategy**


**What we offer**

- Competitive salary and equity package
- Medical, dental and vision plans for employees and any dependents
- 401k Pension Plan
- 26 days of paid time off annually + local bank holidays
- Flexible working hours and a healthy 40-hour workweek
- Company offsite
- Work in an international, diverse, dynamic, and passionate team with a friendly and supportive company culture

**Our values**

Ownership, Transparency, Humility. More here: [https://spacelift.io/careers](https://spacelift.io/careers)

Join Us! At Spacelift, you won’t just be working on a technical product - you’ll be part of a team shaping the future of DevOps. Apply to contribute to a platform loved by its users and take your career to the next level!
